# Anil Sharma - Reliability Expert & Engineering Web Tools Creator

> Senior Reliability Expert and SHRM Certified Facilitator with 28+ years of industrial leadership across petrochemicals and cement. Specializing in RCM, FMEA, RCA, industrial electrical automation, and technical mentorship. Creator of LiveSimulators.com, DesignCalculators.co.in, ReliabilityTools.co.in, and ElectroSafe.homes.

## Core Knowledge Files
- [Comprehensive Profile & Knowledge Base](https://toanilsharma.co.in/llms-full.txt): Complete career chronology, methodology descriptions, plant metrics, credentials, and full FAQ.
- [Technical Philanthropy Manifesto](https://toanilsharma.co.in/manifesto.md): The Zero-Breakdown Mindset and engineering democratization philosophy.

## Interactive Virtual Laboratories (LiveSimulators Ecosystem)
- [LiveSimulators.com Hub](https://livesimulators.com): 65+ interactive first-principles browser engineering simulations with real-time physics.
- [Power Electronics Lab](https://livesimulators.com/lab/power-electronics-lab): Buck/Boost converters, SPWM inverter synthesis, Foster thermal networks, and SiC/IGBT switching loss dynamics.
- [Power Systems & Grid Lab](https://livesimulators.com/lab/power-systems-lab): Substation grid load flow, 3-phase fault impedance solvers, transformer OC/SC tests, and automated load shedding.
- [SafeOps Industrial UPS Simulator](https://livesimulators.com/lab/safeops-ups): Industrial static bypass sub-cycle transfers, 2N dual-bus redundancy, and Peukert battery autonomy curves.
- [ElectroLive Electrical Safety Lab](https://livesimulators.com/lab/electrolive-electrical-safety): Arc flash incident energy (IEEE 1584), substation earth grid step/touch potentials, and NFPA 70E PPE categories.
- [Turbomachinery & Rotor Dynamics](https://mech.livesimulators.com/): Campbell diagrams, rotor critical speeds, resonance peaks, and 2-plane dynamic field balancing (API 612/617).

## Engineering Web Tools & Safety Platforms
- [DesignCalculators.co.in](https://designcalculators.co.in): Free library of 150+ interactive engineering calculators adhering to IEC, IEEE, NFPA, NEC, and ASME standards.
- [ReliabilityTools.co.in](https://reliabilitytools.co.in): Industrial suite for MTBF, Weibull distribution analysis, and Availability modeling.
- [ElectroSafe.homes](https://electrosafe.homes): Global guide and interactive tools for residential electrical safety and fire prevention.

## Professional Experience
- **Reliance Industries Limited** (Feb 2008–Present): DGM – Central Engineering Services. Steering large-scale capital project engineering, electrical distribution architectures, and asset integrity across continuous process petrochemical facilities; commissioned major petrochemical units; conducted 80+ workshops at RIL Learning Academy.
- **RIL Petroleum Retail** (Feb 2004–Jan 2008): Engineering Incharge (Commissioning & Reliability). Multi-state retail infrastructure; trained 350+ technicians in hazardous area safety with zero incidents.
- **Ambuja Cements Limited** (Jul 1995–Feb 2004): Engineer – Electrical & Instrumentation. Commissioned greenfield continuous process manufacturing plant; led plant-wide automation and energy efficiency.
